svg.title: Open at most K epochs; retain complete outcomes and apply the gate at any covered prefix. Expire it as the drift clock advances. Retuning the physical reader requires new calibration or an independently justified transformation rule. Neither template counts nor old calibration identify an unknown bath law or path-blind Hamiltonian. Let Dt ∈{0, 1} be the predictable production/deploy gate at global clock slot t, with Wt = Ct = 0 outside production. Let et and qt be its predictable certified error upper bound and conclusive lower bound; values outside production are immaterial. Write Nn = P t≤n Dt for the number of deployed production trials. The global confidence event includes future calibration and must not be conditioned on as initial information. For analysis stop at the first completed probe prefix whose true counter means miss their intervals; its probability is at most α.
